row.notes: Under EnterCriticalSection([this]) iterates all occupied map slots (bitmap words at [this+0x70], 24-byte entries, value at +0x10), then the lists [this+0xa0..0xa8] and [this+0xc0..0xc8], comparing the 128-bit id param_2 with the second id at [actor+8]+0x98; returns the actor or 0. Old note (returns first set bit) was wrong. Callers 0x1401e9895 (Game_SceneManager_BuildMaterialActorForScene), 0x154334717 (0x1543345d0). (lane owner review requested)
